description:

description:

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E8 — The Big Foot In My Mouth Episode
When Mona discovers a potential new talent Zora (guest star Tamyra Gray), she gets more than she bargains for when Zora makes a move on her.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E9 — The Big College Admission Episode
After years of claiming to be nothing more than friends, Spencer and Mona are shocked when Spencer’s cousin Chauncey is hired at Delicious Records and recalls the night in college when he caught Mona and Spencer having drunken sex.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E10 — The Big Bitter Baby Shower Episode
Big Dee Dee’s baby shower turns cold when Mona feels her confidence has been betrayed after learning that Dee Dee has told her cousin Barbara (guest star Shari Headley) that Mona’s relationship problems stem from her mother’s bitterness.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E11 — The Big How The Ex Stole Christmas Episode
When Dee Dee’s ex-boyfriend comes over for the family holiday dinner, he announces that he is getting married, and Mona warns Dee Dee against an effort to win him back.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E12 — The Big Double Date With My Mate Episode
When Mona gets set up on a date with Camille’s best friend Carlo (guest star Antonio Sabato Jr.), she is taken by his charm and good looks until he admits he’s actually in love with Camille.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E13 — The Big 'you're Not The Boss Of Me' Episode
When an uptight new boss (guest star MC Lyte) does some downsizing at Delicious Records, Mona and Spencer struggle to impress her and keep their jobs.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E15 — The Big I Haven't The Vegas Idea Episode
When Dee Dee’s formerly overweight childhood friend, Aurora, shows up with a sexy new physique, the rebounding Spencer whisks her off for a wild night in Las Vegas, but when they awake the next morning, they believe that they may have gotten married.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E17 — The Big Labor Of Love Episode
Dee Dee becomes hysterical when her mother goes into labor, while Mona remains calm; a motivational speaker (Evan Marriott) influences Charles.

title: Half & Half
description:

Mona discovers that her new vice president title comes with new, sometimes unpleasant, responsibilities as she's forced to fire her friend and assistant Adam at the request of her boss Kai.
